name: Enthalpy v0.4.30
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.30

## Changes

- On macOS, sign-out and sign-in can remove saved account credentials from an
  earlier app build. This fixes a credential-store error after an update.
- Sign-in shows the remaining wait after too many failed attempts. The Sign in
  button becomes available when the wait ends. It does not send your password
  again automatically.
- You can correct your password while the countdown runs.

## Test this preview

Sign out, then sign in again. Check that the correct account and workspace
list appear. If a sign-in wait appears, check that the countdown ends and the
Sign in button becomes available.

## Known limits

Recovery email is not available. After a workspace is restored from Trash,
this preview cannot restore its devices' Sync access. Existing local files
remain available after sign-in. The original OneDrive failure still needs
further testing.
